description.value:
You've deeply studied certain beneficial spells to speedily enter Arcane Cascade when you cast them. When you cast a studious spell, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Arcane Cascade] as a free action as your next action this turn. Add any studious spell you gain to your spellbook if you don't know it already. Your studious spells are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gecko Grip] and an additional spell depending on your hybrid study, listed in the hybrid study's entry.

At 11th level, add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Haste] and an additional spell depending on your hybrid study to your studious spells. At 13th level, add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fly] and an additional spell depending on your hybrid study to your studious spells.
